name: SkyNest
blurb: Full-stack hotel management platform covering the booking lifecycle: inventory and availability search, reservations with date-overlap validation, guest records, check-in/out and billing.
detail: Normalised PostgreSQL schema with referential integrity and indexed availability queries behind server-side API routes. Responsive Next.js + TypeScript frontend with server-side rendering and role-separated admin and guest views. Dockerised and deployed on Vercel.
